marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech & AI Sector
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed tech giants reported increased capital expenditure towards proprietary LLMs and AI infrastructure alongside steady cloud revenue growth.
marketLayer.inference: Near-term profit margins may experience mild pressure due to heavy capex, but long-term monetization paths for enterprise AI tools are strengthening.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving regulatory guidelines around data security and high-end hardware export restrictions.

marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Hardware Momentum
marketLayer.fact: US chipmakers rallied following Q2 earnings beats driven by sustained hyperscaler demand for AI server hardware and next-gen memory chips.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained capital commitment from US mega-caps provides a strong positive signal for broader hardware supply chain equities in Asia.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Federal Reserve monetary policy trajectory and high bond yields weighing on growth stock valuations.

marketLayer.title: Chinese EV Manufacturers & Auto Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: Leading HK-listed EV manufacturers disclosed positive monthly delivery trends and accelerated opening of retail channels across emerging overseas markets.
marketLayer.inference: Higher export volumes are expected to offset domestic price competition and improve consolidated gross profit margins.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential regulatory shifts and geopolitical trade barriers targeting imported Chinese electric vehicles.
